summary: The first v36 comparison build failed closed on missing Pillow; after pinning Pillow 12.3.0, v37 produced the 660-frame comparison, poster, and manifest for the PARTIAL web demo.
evidence: v36 stopped before rendering with ModuleNotFoundError: PIL and was not reused.
v37 emits a 27.5-second synchronized comparison with SHA-256 1f0a9bd7f91c871b38c189dc51e51cea920d2ec8a737dbe154f8df87f465d7ff.
The robot-only public artifact has SHA-256 44b10a8a3eeb6b3aaabfaf0fbde77818f5959873768ad86c30777213c61b5c90.
lessons: Media builders need a declared Pillow preflight in addition to ffmpeg and ffprobe.
limitations: Publishing the comparison does not promote the underlying 13/14 visual contract to WORKING.
next_actions: Verify the deployed asset hashes and content types after GitHub Pages completes.
